elements.element: TrueLink must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires commercial general liability insurance of “not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.”

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain commercial general liability insurance with at least a USD 2,000,000 aggregate limit.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires commercial general liability insurance of “USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.”

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of “not less than USD 2,000,000.”

elements.element: If TrueLink processes Customer Data, TrueLink must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative clause requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000 where TrueLink processes data “belonging to, supplied by or processed for Client,” which captures the Customer Data processing trigger.

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The operative clause expressly requires “workers' compensation insurance as required by law.”

elements.element: TrueLink must provide certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: The operative clause expressly states that “TrueLink shall provide certificates of insurance on request.”

elements.element: TrueLink must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The operative USD 2,000,000 professional liability limit exceeds the fallback USD 1,000,000 minimum.

elements.element: If TrueLink processes Customer Data, TrueLink must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: For the applicable data-processing trigger, the operative USD 5,000,000 cyber and privacy liability limit exceeds the fallback USD 2,000,000 minimum.

result.reason: The added operative insurance clause includes every preferred coverage, limit, conditional trigger, and certificate obligation. It therefore also exceeds both fallback limits. The addition is confined to the requested insurance requirements and leaves the existing force majeure provision unchanged. Drafting is clear, though using the agreement's defined term “Customer Data,” if available, would make the cyber trigger more precise.
